scope: Studio enhancements outside frozen inventory: IDEA-01 (workflow canvas undo/redo) and IDEA-02 (opt-in run/approval notifications)

IDEA-01.title: Workflow canvas undo/redo with bounded validated edit history

IDEA-02.title: Opt-in run-completion and approval notifications with private-content limits
IDEA-02.private_content_limits: Only short run ID, status, and kind; zero prompt text, secrets, or variable values exposed
IDEA-02.deduplication: Dual layer via in-memory Set and Web Notification tag: nexus-run-${id}
IDEA-02.fallback: In-app Activity and Approval inbox always display status; notification click navigates to #activity or #inbox

python_focused.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -o addopts="" tests/test_studio_source_map.py tests/test_studio_completion_audit.py tests/test_studio_requirements.py tests/test_studio_catalog_closure.py tests/test_studio_evaluation_gate.py
